# drotm

[All examples](index.md) · [Document profile](../reference/studio-draft-examples.md)

Use the expanded modified Givens matrix for (3,4) to rotate the vector. The two components become 6.25 and 0.

## What this example demonstrates

Use the expanded modified Givens matrix for (3,4) to rotate the vector. The two components become 6.25 and 0.
